#### <a id="lrn-002"></a>LRN-002 · Engagement levels L0–L4 with consent

**Epic** · ✅ Done · P0 · owner MisanaProger

L0 questions only, L1 hints, L2 explanations and pages, L3–L4 code; one-step escalation with explicit consent; conceptual questions answered at every level.

- **Parent:** [LRN-001](#lrn-001) Assessment methodology in place (Done)
- **Implemented by:** [PRD-004](product.md#prd-004) Chat-first mentor with engagement levels (Done)

**Acceptance criteria**

- [x] Rules are deterministic (est-ai-policy/src/engagement.rs) and unit-tested

**Components:** [`crates/est-ai-policy/src/engagement.rs`](../../crates/est-ai-policy/src/engagement.rs), [`crates/est-domain/src/engagement.rs`](../../crates/est-domain/src/engagement.rs)

#### <a id="lrn-003"></a>LRN-003 · ADI observed-0.2

**Epic** · ✅ Done · P0 · owner MisanaProger

Issue score from observed events (answers by level, own commits, rejected escalations, conceptual questions, copied code), aggregated with double decay by time and by number of later Issues.

- **Parent:** [LRN-001](#lrn-001) Assessment methodology in place (Done)
- **Implemented by:** [PRD-006](product.md#prd-006) ADI and Skill Matrix (Done)
- **Validated by:** [RND-003](research.md#rnd-003) ADI coefficients and decay calibration (Proposed), [RND-004](research.md#rnd-004) Threshold for a stable ADI status (Proposed)

**Acceptance criteria**

- [x] scoring_version is stored with every assessment
- [x] Escalation without using the help does not raise the ADI

**Components:** [`crates/est-dependency`](../../crates/est-dependency)

#### <a id="lrn-004"></a>LRN-004 · Skill Matrix esm-catalog-0.2

**Epic** · ✅ Done · P0 · owner MisanaProger

10 disciplines with skills; five dimensions (Theory, Practice, Diagnosis, Transfer, Independence); statuses not_assessed, insufficient_evidence, provisional, established, needs_reassessment (180 days); confidence by number of references; source weights.

- **Parent:** [LRN-001](#lrn-001) Assessment methodology in place (Done)
- **Implemented by:** [PRD-006](product.md#prd-006) ADI and Skill Matrix (Done)
- **Validated by:** [RND-005](research.md#rnd-005) ESM source weights (Proposed)
- **Extended by:** [TEC-022](technical.md#tec-022) Graph model and catalog as data (Planned), [LRN-020](#lrn-020) Forgetting signals and reassessment triggers (Proposed)

**Acceptance criteria**

- [x] Missing data is not_assessed, never zero
- [x] Reading and abandoned Issues are not evidence

**Components:** [`crates/est-discipline`](../../crates/est-discipline), [`crates/est-application/src/skills.rs`](../../crates/est-application/src/skills.rs)

##### <a id="lrn-012"></a>LRN-012 · Seven evidence types and their rules

**Feature** · ▶ Ready · P0 · owner MisanaProger

independent_solution, hinted_solution, self_correction, explanation, repeated_application, new_context_application, control_task — each defined by observable conditions.

- **Parent:** [LRN-011](#lrn-011) Evidence model (Planned)
- **Implemented by:** [TEC-013](technical.md#tec-013) Evidence derivation from observed events (Planned)
- **Validated by:** [RND-007](research.md#rnd-007) Independence estimation (Proposed)

**Acceptance criteria**

- [ ] Each type has a definition in observable terms (events, levels, tests) in the specification
- [ ] Types are mutually exclusive per (reference, skill) except repeated/new-context, which add to the base type
- [ ] Explanation evidence requires a checked answer (quiz or reviewed reflection), not the model's opinion

**Documentation:** [`docs/specifications/evidence-assessment.md#types`](../../docs/specifications/evidence-assessment.md#types)

**Source:** TZ 2.1

##### <a id="lrn-013"></a>LRN-013 · Evidence reliability

**Feature** · ▶ Ready · P0 · owner MisanaProger

A reliability grade per record (high, medium, low) from how the result was checked: automated tests and server-graded quizzes are high; self-report and model review are low.

- **Parent:** [LRN-011](#lrn-011) Evidence model (Planned)
- **Implemented by:** [TEC-013](technical.md#tec-013) Evidence derivation from observed events (Planned)

**Acceptance criteria**

- [ ] The grade is a pure function of the record's check method and completeness
- [ ] Low-reliability evidence cannot make a skill established on its own

**Documentation:** [`docs/specifications/evidence-assessment.md#reliability`](../../docs/specifications/evidence-assessment.md#reliability)

##### <a id="lrn-014"></a>LRN-014 · Help accounting per evidence

**Feature** · ▶ Ready · P0 · owner MisanaProger

Each record stores the highest level used, hints by stage and whether code from the mentor was copied — the observed facts already used by the ADI, now per skill.

- **Parent:** [LRN-011](#lrn-011) Evidence model (Planned)
- **Needed by:** [LRN-024](#lrn-024) Hint budget (Proposed)
- **Implemented by:** [TEC-012](technical.md#tec-012) Evidence record in the domain (Ready)
- **Validated by:** [RND-007](research.md#rnd-007) Independence estimation (Proposed)

**Acceptance criteria**

- [ ] Help is recorded from events, not inferred from text
- [ ] The ADI and the Skill Matrix remain independent: help changes the evidence type, not the ADI

**Documentation:** [`docs/specifications/evidence-assessment.md#record`](../../docs/specifications/evidence-assessment.md#record)
